name: cstar-forge
raw_meta_yaml:
# rattler-build (v1) recipe for cstar-forge.

schema_version: 1

context:
  # cstar-forge has moved into cstar-ocean (C-Star 0.15.0). From 0.9.0 this
  # package is a compatibility shim: its `cstar_forge.*` modules forward to
  # `cstar.*` with a DeprecationWarning naming the new path.
  version: "0.9.0"
  python_min: "3.12"

package:
  name: cstar-forge
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/cstar-forge/cstar_forge-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b0ed4982a3df3f858888c2c3f0e38dbe428da843d6eb328072d6c7f8ce04d021

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  # No activate.d hooks any more: cstar-ocean now ships the PYTHONNOUSERSITE hooks.
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=64
    - setuptools-scm >=8
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    # Everything forge needs -- code, data, wizard, CLI -- is in cstar-ocean now;
    # this package only carries the import-compatibility shim.
    - cstar-ocean >=0.15.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cstar_forge
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - cstar forge --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/CWorthy-ocean/cstar-forge
  summary: Compatibility shim -- cstar-forge has moved into cstar-ocean (cstar.applications.forge)
  description: |
    C-Star Forge, the ROMS-MARBL domain generator, now lives inside
    cstar-ocean (`cstar.applications.forge`, `cstar.catalog`, `cstar.wizard`,
    and the `cstar forge` CLI). This package is a compatibility shim: it depends
    on cstar-ocean and re-exports the old `cstar_forge` import paths with a
    deprecation warning. Install cstar-ocean directly for new environments.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ScottEilerman
